messages:
harper: Heads-up: planned maintenance for az31-edge tonight 00:45-02:15 UTC. Scope: TOR NIC microcode + selective BMC firmware flash + staggered GPU node soft reboots. Goal: resolve packet re-ordering seen on large-batch tails. Expect brief cold-kv reseed and short enqueue windows.

harper: Cohorts: 5 cohorts, 1 rack each, 7m gap. We'll avoid dedicated hosts (label dedicated=true).

oleg: Runbook sketch:
- 00:15 UTC: push HPA min+1 + PDB relax PR
- 00:30 UTC: eu-canary preheat to validate kv hit-rate and routing fallback
- 00:45 UTC: cohort A cordon -> kvseed preheat -> drain after hit-rate >= 0.7 or 10m
- subsequent cohorts start every 7m; BMC flash only if Node is in cohort and shows stuck sensor.

maia: Command snippets (controlplane):
```
./tools/kvseed --region=az31 --cohort=A --concurrency=4 --target-hit=0.7
kubectl cordon gpu-az31-03 && kubectl drain gpu-az31-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
```

oleg: Routing note: upstream ISP link has some history of flapping. We'll use announce-suppression per cohort for 2m and smart-routing will prefer us-east/eu-west for new sessions. Existing sessions stay sticky.

maia: Cost: finance pre-authorized a $2k ops buffer for emergency on-demand backfill. Tag any burst with "az31-isp-flap".

finance-bot: [info] Ops buffer available: $2,000. Auto-tag rule active for this ticket.

harper: Rollback triggers: p95 inference latency > 240ms for 5m OR error rate increase > 2% for 5m OR kv hit-rate < 0.65 after 12m preheat. If BGP withdraw flaps more than 3 times in 10m, abort remaining cohorts.

oleg: To reduce autoscaler churn we'll bump HPA cooldown to 6m and raise floor by 1 during the window; also temporarily increase PDB to allow single-eviction.

maia: I'll own canary validation and post kv hit-rate + p95 snapshots at each cohort boundary. I'll also watch for packet re-ordering metrics.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance ticket INF-2026-312 created. Window: 2026-05-06T00:45:00Z - 2026-05-06T02:15:00Z. Pager: infra/eng-sre.

harper: Final checklist before 00:10 UTC: PR merged, canary validated, warmpool/backup nodes provisioned, billing tag configured. Ping @oncall on any abnormal tail metrics. Good luck, night crew.
